newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ITALY PUSH TO JOIN FIVE NATIONS WITH SCOTLAND TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ITALY PUSH TO JOIN FIVE NATIONS WITH SCOTLAND TEST.

text.p: Italy, jolted by their 54-21 defeat by England last month, will seek to improve their hopes of joining the Five Nations championship when they take on Scotland at Murrayfield on Saturday.

Manager Francesco Cimino is delighted the match has taken on the status of a full test, especially as the Italians won 29-17 against a Scotland A team, the full national side in all but name, in Rieti in January.
"We need to play very strong sides regularly because our own internal championship does not prepare us for international rugby," he said.
"We have only two or three good sides and then there is a big drop off in standard."
The Italians have internationals against all the Five Nations countries this season as they continue their push for a six nations European tournament.
So far the Italians have lost narrowly at home to Wales before losing heavily to Australia and England but in the last of those matches they showed flashes of exciting, running rugby.
At Twickenham, they scored three superb second-half tries, one of them a gem from wing Paolo Vaccari, which will serve as a warning to the Scottish defence.
The home side have recalled their most capped player Scott Hastings as well as veteran lock Andy Reed following their defeat to Australia last month.

Without the injured Gary Armstrong at scrum-half, they will be looking for half-backs Bryan Redpath and Craig Chalmers to give gifted young centre and captain Gregor Townsend the opportunity to split the defence.

Scotland: 15-Rowen Shepherd; 14-Tony Stanger, 13-Scott Hastings, 12-Gregor Townsend (captain), 11-Kenny Logan; 10-Craig Chalmers, 9-Bryan Redpath; 8-Eric Peters, 7-Ian Smith, 6-Murray Wallace; 5-Andy Reed, 4-Damian Cronin; 3-Mattie Stewart, 2-Kevin McKenzie, 1-David Hilton.

Italy: 15-Javier Pertile; 14-Nicola Mazzucato, 13-Paolo Vaccari, 12-Ivan Francescato, 11-Marcello Cuttitta; 10-Diego Dominguez, 9-Alessandro Troncon; 8-Orazio Arancio, 7-Andrea Sgorlon, 6-Massimo Giovanelli (captain); 5-Giambattista Croci, 4-Walter Cristofoletto; 3-Andrea Castellani, 2-Carlo Orlandi, 1-Massimo Cuttitta.
